ns2:course.label: Civic Engagement in Wellness
ns2:course.description: Provides scholarly knowledge and practical experience related to environmental, intellectual, physical, psychological, spiritual, and social wellness. Students acquire leadership and real-world skills while working in teams to develop and implement projects that facilitate health and well-being in the population of adults living in the community. Projects emphasize integrative learning and are showcased in both written and oral formats. Same as CHLH 365, KIN 365, RST 365, and SHS 370.
